title: Municipal Councils And Urban Councils (Amendment) Law
long_title: A LAW TO AMEND THE MUNICIPAL COUNCILS ORDINANCE AND THE URBAN COUNCILS ORDINANCE
amends_recorded_elsewhere: Municipal Councils Ordinance; Urban Councils Ordinance

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: National State Assembly of the Republic of Sri Lanka as follows: - Short title
body.raw_text: 1. This Law may be cited as the Municipal Councils and Urban Councils (Amendment) Law, No. 18 of 1977.
body.text: This Law may be cited as the Municipal Councils and Urban Councils (Amendment) Law, No. 18 of 1977.

body.heading: Amendment of section 272 of the Municipal Councils Ordinance (Chapter 252)
body.raw_text: 2. The Municipal Councils Ordinance is hereby amended in section 272 thereof, by the insertion, immediately after paragraph (31), of the following new paragraph:- "(32) The control of parking of motor vehicles within the Municipality by providing parking places and collecting the prescribed fee for parking such motor vehicles in such places: Provided that the preceding provisions of this paragraph shall not apply in respect of motor vehicles of the Ceylon Transport Board."
body.text: The Municipal Councils Ordinance is hereby amended in section 272 thereof, by the insertion, immediately after paragraph (31), of the following new paragraph:- "(32) The control of parking of motor vehicles within the Municipality by providing parking places and collecting the prescribed fee for parking such motor vehicles in such places: Provided that the preceding provisions of this paragraph shall not apply in respect of motor vehicles of the Ceylon Transport Board."

body.heading: Amendment of section 157 of the Urban Councils Ordinance (Chapter 255)
body.raw_text: 3. The Urban Councils Ordinance is hereby amended in section 157 thereof, by the insertion, immediately after paragraph (14), of the following new paragraph: - "(14A) The control of parking of motor vehicles within the Urban Council area by providing parking places and collecting the prescribed fee for parking such motor vehicles in such places: Provided that the preceding provisions of this paragraph shall not apply in respect of motor vehicles of the Ceylon Transport Board.".
